## Idealista data exploration

```{r packages}

library(aws.s3)
library(readr)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tools)
library(mapSpain)
library(ggplot2)
library(classInt)
```

```{r loading files}

lire <- function(fichier) {
  s3read_using(
    FUN = read_csv,
    object = paste0("idealista/", fichier),
    bucket = "mperier",
    opts = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
  )
}

idealista <- lire("202606_residential_metrics_idealistadata_v2.csv")

```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
